body.x: READY TO CUT THE CORD?URBANEARS(URBANEARS.COM), a maker of listening devices especially in headphones, announced a wireless headphone "Plattan ADV" at CES Unveiled, a pre-show of CES 2015 which runs Jan. 6-9 in Las Vegas.The Plattan ADV Wireless headphone(Plattan ADV) is the first Bluetooth headphone in the Urbanears line-up. It comes with a built-in microphone, a swipe interface on the ear cup and it is ready for 8-hours solid playtime before recharging. Also, there are innovative features like the machine washable headband, collapsible structure, ZoundPlug and equalizer.Plattan ADV has a new 3D hinge technology that automatically adjusts to the users' ears and head for a soft and comfortable fit. The headband of this earphone is made of fabric and can be easily snapped off and thrown in the wash. Also it comes with an interchangeable cable, allowing you to choose to wear on either the left or right side.Held annually in January and owned and produced by the Consumer Electronics Association (CEA), CES 2015 is the world's largest IT and consumer electronics exhibition to see the latest global trends in consumer electronics industry in one spot.Globally recognized for its record in the number of published articles for CES, AVING News has been sending its reporters to CES every year to deliver the fastest and freshest news on the spot.
